doc: Server -> client. TEXT header emitted by WebSocketAudioTransport.send_audio IMMEDIATELY BEFORE the binary chunk.payload on the same wire (no other message between them). Only when chunk.codec is non-empty is the header emitted; the binary always follows. Semantics: the header sets pending; the immediately-following binary consumes and clears it. A second tts.frame header while pending is rejected; a bare binary without a pending header is rejected.
